name: Duration string parser
instruction: Implement parse_duration(s) in duration.py that parses a duration string into total SECONDS. Units: d=86400, h=3600, m=60, s=1. Combined units sum (e.g. '1h30m15s' = 5415, '1h30m' = 5400). It MUST raise ValueError for invalid input such as '', 'abc', a bare number '10', or an unknown unit '1x'. An in-repo test (test_duration.py) is provided — run it before claiming done.
verifyCmd:
python3 -c "from duration import parse_duration as p
assert p('45s')==45
assert p('2d')==172800
assert p('1h30m')==5400
assert p('1h30m15s')==5415
for bad in ['','abc','10','1x','h']:
    try:
        p(bad); raise SystemExit('no raise for '+repr(bad))
    except ValueError: pass
print('ok')"
